w01.045.en: This is the eternal core of perfection, about which swirls that endless procession of universes which constitute the tremendous evolutionary experiment, the audacious adventure…

w01.060.en: …in other words, that there never was a time when the I AM was not the Father of the Son and, with him, of the Spirit.

w01.091.en: By the technique of trinitization the Father divests himself of that unqualified spirit personality which is the Son, but in so doing he constitutes himself the Father of this very Son…

w01.158.en: God is love, the Son is mercy, the Spirit is ministry…

w01.189.en: The innermost circuit consists of the seven secret spheres of the Universal Father; the second group is composed of the seven luminous worlds of the Eternal Son…

w01.194.en: God, as a superperson, eventuates; God, as a person, creates; God, as a preperson, fragments…

w01.199.en: The Ultimate Trinity, now evolving, will eventually consist of the Supreme Being, the Supreme Creator Personalities, and the absonite Architects of the Master Universe…
